aboutSection.title: We always bring the best medical services for your health
aboutSection.description1: At MedCure, we understand the importance of convenient access to medical services. Our mission is to simplify finding and booking appointments with reputable doctors, helping you receive the care you need on time.
aboutSection.description2: We strive for a world where everyone can easily access healthcare services. Whether it's routine checkups, specialist consultations, or emergencies, we always work to connect you with the right doctor quickly and efficiently.

items.title: Quality Doctor Team
items.description: Our platform partners with experienced doctors dedicated to providing the best quality medical care for you.

items.title: 24/7 Service
items.description: Access, find doctors and book appointments anytime, anywhere — including nights, weekends and holidays.

items.title: Quality Lab Services
items.description: Linked with certified laboratories; fast, accurate results support effective diagnosis.

items.title: Free Initial Consultation
items.description: Start your healthcare journey easily with a free first consultation.

waySection.title: Accompanying you on your healthy journey with MedCure
waySection.description: We prioritize your health with personalized and accessible services — making medical care simpler.

items.question: How do I book an appointment?
items.answer: You can log in or create an account, find a doctor by specialty, area or available time and confirm your booking.

items.question: Can I book an appointment online?
items.answer: Yes. Just access the system, choose a suitable doctor/clinic and complete your booking in a few steps.

items.question: Is my personal information secure?
items.answer: All data is encrypted and only shared with doctors with your consent.

items.question: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
items.answer: You can cancel or reschedule before the appointment time according to the clinic/doctor's policy.

items.question: How do I find the right doctor/specialist?
items.answer: You can filter by specialty, location, availability, ratings and cost to choose the right doctor.
